class: A required choice with no label was neither answered nor reported blank, so the run said everything was filled
symptom: Bitdeer (Breezy HR): the required select 'Which location are you applying for *' (San Jose, CA / Austin, TX) stayed empty, the page showed 'Preferred location is required', and the run still reported 'Every required field is filled and the form shows no errors' (ready_to_submit).
root_cause: Two faults. (1) No answer family covered 'which location are you applying for' with a list of offices, so the question reached no profile fact. (2) The required-field scan took a select's value as proof it was filled; Angular's unknown option is <option value="?"></option>, a non-empty value for an empty choice, so the select counted as filled and the report was clean.
why_tests_missed: Select tests used placeholders with an empty value. None used a placeholder whose value is not empty, and no test asked an office-list question.
fix: answer_engine.office_applying_for chooses the one office whose US state the owner can work (matched through geo_reference, no state named in code) and leaves two or no fitting offices to the owner. The required-field scan treats a select whose chosen option shows no text as blank.
prevention: Judge whether a choice was made by what the control shows, not by its value attribute, and make 'every required field is filled' depend on the page's own required flag and error text as well as on the agent's own inventory.
